It does not provide the correct tool, operator, parameters, or arguments. For a final answer, copy the exact terminal successful calculator result without rounding values, renaming reference IDs, or changing numeric types; follow answer_schema and agent_contract_guidance exactly. Address any Host feedback before stopping. rationale_summary must be one short sentence of at most 240 characters. Do not copy the task/context or provide hidden chain-of-thought.
